programme.title: Match Made At Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic, small-town girl Holly and realist, career-driven Chris aren't a likely pair, but when "matched" together by Holly's all-knowing great-aunt, they don't have much of a choice.

programme.title: Christmas Time
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers try to reconnect at Christmas but there's something that one of them can't get past: the other thinks he's a time traveler.

programme.title: A Very Country Christmas
programme.desc: When Country superstar Zane Gunther is looking to escape the chaos of fame, he retreats to the small town where he had fond childhood memories. There he meets a single mother, Jeanette Williams, who’s trying to make the best life for her and her daughter, Quinn. With little time for herself, let alone romance, will working with Zane on the local Christmas Concert be just what Jeannette needs to open her heart to the possibility of love?

programme.title: Christmas with A Prince: The Royal Baby
programme.desc: Things get complicated for the expecting Prince Alexander and Dr. Tasha when a Royal State Visit is planned abroad, passing through her hometown. The couple must struggle with defying tradition and delivering, literally, on expectations.

programme.title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
programme.desc: A wreathmaker slips on ice and injures her arm which puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy until a selfless neighbor steps up to keep her business afloat.

programme.title: The Fabric of Christmas
programme.desc: Liam, a fireman, and Amy, a quilting teacher, team up to make a Christmas quilt for Liam's sister's wedding. As they navigate their feelings for each other, they must decide what is truly important in time for the holiday season.

programme.title: A Christmas Dance Reunion
programme.desc: A successful attorney, Lucy is reunited with her childhood Christmas dance partner Barrett, as the pair give a resort a new lease on life and the passion between the pair heats up.

programme.title: Santa’s Got Style
programme.desc: Madison Jacobs is a luxury department store executive who wants to think outside the box for this year’s holiday season. This year, she dreams up a Stylin’ Santa; who will showcase a perfectly tailored red designer suit. She calls up Ethan Davis, a retired model and current owner of a modelling agency. Ethan has been interested in Madison for quite some time. While struggling to find her the perfect model he resorts to modeling-under-cover as “Mr.S” himself.
